verdict.rationale: Docs confirm function tools get 'automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation,' plus structured outputs and guardrails for input/output checks — real schema-validation machinery. However, this is runtime validation (Pydantic) rather than true 'build-time' static type checking, and no evidence shows a static-analysis or compile-time error-catching workflow (e.g., mypy integration) as the story specifically claims. Missing for 10: evidence of static/build-time type-checking tooling, IDE/CI integration for catching schema mistakes before execution, and independent hands-on confirmation that validation errors are surfaced pre-runtime.
